AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.

2. When learning Introduction to Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Aviation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Aviation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Aviation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Aviation.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

5. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Aircraft Components, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Components.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Components.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Components.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Components.

8. When learning Airport Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Airport Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airport Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airport Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airport Safety.

9. When learning Aircraft Tools and Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Tools and Materials.

10. When learning Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.

11. When learning Safety in the Aviation Workplace, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Aviation Workplace.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.

12. When learning Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Airport Business Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Aviation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
